rules.applies_when: a test is defined or executed
acceptance: threshold and unit are defined before execution
PASS result meets every stated expected condition
rules.failure_policy: incomplete contract is NOT_RUN not PASS

rules.applies_when: failure behavior is part of the contract
actions: test empty minimum maximum oversized corrupt timeout duplicate concurrent cancel and restart cases as applicable
acceptance: invalid input is rejected without corruption or hang
subsequent valid operation succeeds or documented safe state persists
rules.failure_policy: retain minimal failing vector and block affected check

acceptance: simulation result is never labeled physical target PASS
omitted timing electrical RF thermal and safety behavior remains unverified
rules.failure_policy: downgrade claim to actual evidence level

rules.applies_when: physical target or instrument evidence is claimed
acceptance: device and firmware match requested target
instrument calibration is valid for measurement
rules.failure_policy: mark BLOCKED or FAIL; do not substitute simulation

acceptance: same reproduction fails before and passes after fix
rules.failure_policy: defect remains open with current diagnosis

actions: retain PASS FAIL BLOCKED NOT_RUN and NOT_APPLICABLE separately
acceptance: non-PASS is not hidden by pass rate
rules.failure_policy: reject misleading report and regenerate from source results
